description: This file defines an abstract class 'MidiPortSelector' used for selecting MIDI ports via a Spinner UI component, managing MIDI device connections, and handling device callbacks. It is part of an Android MIDI sample project.

classes.name: MidiPortSelector
classes.description: An abstract class for selecting MIDI ports using a UI spinner, managing connected devices, and handling port state changes.

methods.name: MidiPortSelector
methods.description: Constructor initializing MIDI manager, activity, spinner, and device callback registration.

methods.name: clearSelection
methods.description: Resets the selection in the spinner to no port.

methods.name: onDeviceAdded
methods.description: Handles the addition of a MIDI device, adding its ports to the adapter.

methods.name: onDeviceRemoved
methods.description: Handles removal of a MIDI device and updates the UI accordingly.

methods.name: onDeviceStatusChanged
methods.description: Updates port availability based on device status changes, managing busy ports.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Calls onClose to clean up resources.
